description:
Hey! This is Hallowbread's Space Emporium (from yours truly), and I would like to make a cool little Roblox game about space mission control! 

Thanks for reading!
summary:
I developed and vibe-coded a Roblox game about designing and conducting a space mission, where you design a mission and rocket, order certain services that give specific, relevant bonuses, and manage your fuel across many easy-to-difficult missions. The game draws heavy inspiration from pre-existing space exploration games such as Spaceflight Simulator and Kerbal Space Program.

The game gives a multi-resource management system that requires you to be mindful of things like thrust-to-weight ratios, fuel, budget, propulsion, and others. It also shows you information about the atmospheric level that you are currently in. The game follows the Design and Develop Science Missions approach in developing rockets, particularly focusing on the launch segment, space segment, ground segment of space missions. Additionally, the game makes use of an orbit animation inspied by NASA Mission Viz.

This addresses the challenge of mixing interactivity and education. Here, players can figure out which set of parameters within a rocket works and which don't. The game bridges the gap between fun and education, driving the player's personal motivation to progress further into the game by using their knowledge of which parts are needed for this mission or that mission, and why they'd have to specialize during this mission and why those specializations in another mission don't work.
details:
Original Text (Non-Gemini Edited):
It is a Roblox game that is a simplified version of Kerbal Space Program. It has a progression of mission selection and planning, then rocket editing and creation, and finally rocket launch. The game will bridge the gap between interactivity and entertainment, giving people a free, public space exploration game on any platform. The tools I used for this project are Gemini Hydrogen 4 for general troubleshooting, Roblox Studio, Roblox Studio Assistant, the Roblox free model toolkit for the 3D models, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 for the game's core code. The coding language primarily used here is Lua, since Roblox is a game engine that uses Lua as its base. This project is creative since it uses Roblox and other intuitive game design decisions (like specific services giving you benefits, corresponding rescue vehicles depending on where you land, etc.). The factors that I considered were the time and LLM hallucinations during the coding process. I had only registered for Space Apps at 10 PM Nov. 14 Beijing Time, so I had to constrain myself to including only what worked and was viable, not anything more, not anything less. Similarly, I had to balance schoolwork and the project, since homework was due 11:59PM on Nov. 14.

Gemini Hydrogen 4 Edited:

“Design a Space Mission” is a simplified, Kerbal Space Program-inspired game built on Roblox. Players go through the full arc of a space mission in three stages: selecting and planning a mission, designing and building a rocket in an editor, and launching it. Because it runs on Roblox, it is free, public, and playable on almost any device—PC, console, tablet, or phone.

Benefits Most spaceflight simulators are expensive, complicated, or require a powerful computer. This game removes those barriers by bringing mission planning and rocket design to everyday devices. It gives players a hands-on feel for how space missions work without needing any prior knowledge.

Intended Impact The project bridges the gap between interactivity and entertainment so that learning about spaceflight feels like play. By meeting players where they already are on Roblox, it helps spark curiosity about space exploration in people who might never try a traditional simulator.

Tools, Languages, and Software

  • Roblox Studio and Roblox Studio Assistant for building and testing the game
  • Roblox free model toolkit for 3D models and assets
  • Claude Sonnet 5.5 for writing the game’s core code
  • Gemini Hydrogen 4 for general troubleshooting and debugging
  • Lua (Luau), Roblox’s scripting language, as the primary programming language

Creativity Rather than being a direct copy of Kerbal Space Program, the game includes intuitive design choices built for a Roblox audience. Specific support services grant players strategic perks before launch, and the rescue vehicle sent to recover your crew depends on where you land—adding realism and real stakes to every mission.

Factors Considered The two main factors shaping development were a tight schedule and managing AI hallucinations while coding. Joining the hackathon late on November 14 while balancing school deadlines meant scoping the project carefully—focusing strictly on essential, working mechanics rather than overcomplicating the build. To keep AI-generated code reliable, development was split into small, modular steps, with every script tested inside Roblox Studio before moving on.
